{{Quote|There's the blockade.|Ric Olié|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The '''Trade Federation fleet''' was the corporate [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Trade Defense Force]].

==History==
===Usage up to Naboo=== 
{{Quote|Forgive me, Lord Sidious, but, as my advisers have pointed out, the redistribution of our vessels carries with it considerable financial risk. To begin with, there is the cost of fuel. Then, with so many ships allocated to an embargo, a disruption in trade in the Mid and Outer Rims for however long the blockade is maintained. Finally, there is no telling how our investors might react to the news. ''[&hellip;]'' We are, after all, Lord Sidious, a commercial enterprise, not a navy.''"<br />"''Even after all I have engineered on your behalf you fail to grasp that by allying with me you are investing in the future. But no matter. Does it not occur to you that your most valued investors are in a position to reap great profits from your knowledge of what is about to happen? Would they not profit from learning that the Xi Char, the Geonosians, and other unionized insectoids have turned their pincers and claws to the manufacture of weapons? Might you not balance your precious budget by gaining from other shipping companies what revenue the Trade Federation risks losing?|Nute Gunray is convinced to prepare the blockade of Naboo by Darth Sidious|<ref name="Plagueis Novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
The defense fleet consisted of capital ships such as [[Captor-class heavy munitions cruiser|heavy munition cruisers]] and [[Lupus-class missile frigate|missile frigates]]. They made heavy use of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] crew, including [[OOM pilot battle droid/Legends|OOM pilot battle droids]], infantry [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of various types, and [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]], but they also carried cadres of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] personnel, often [[Human/Legends|humans]], including their [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] and [[TDF officer]]s, and other personnel such as scout pilots and companies of troops.<ref name="RP">''[[Rogue Planet]]''</ref>

After the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the Trade Federation was forced to hand over warships to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]], leading to Federation ships and crews serving in the Republic-led [[Second Battle of Zonama Sekot]].<ref name="RP" />

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|When Darth Sidious asked me to loan you the Federation fleet, he didn't say you were going to war! Bane, you've already lost four of my ships! I hope you can pay for all of this!"''<br />''"One authentic Jedi holocron and the memory crystal I was after. When my benefactor gets this, he will compensate you for your puny fleet.|Nute Gunray and Cad Bane|<ref name="Cargo of Doom" />}}
[[File:Devaron_system.png|thumb|right|300px|Several ''Munificent''-class frigates that had joined the ranks of the Trade Federation fleet were destroyed in the Battle of Devaron.]]
In the years before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Trade Federation subsequently regained a military force, including missile frigates of pre-Naboo design which fought in a picket role at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], and large new cruiser and destroyer designs using [[Core ship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class core ships]] as command modules.<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> With the advent of the Clone Wars, the Federation fleet could act as part of the greater [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]<ref name="Cargo of Doom" /> despite the company's supposed neutrality.<ref name="Sphere">{{TCW|Sphere of Influence}}</ref> [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]], major vessels in the Separatist navy<ref name="Cargo of Doom" /> that had originally belonged to the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]],<ref name="ROTSICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> also found their way into the Federation's private fleet. For the [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|Battle of Devaron]], Gunray loaned the Separatist-hired [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] five Munificents from the Federation fleet on the order of Sidious. Gunray, however, became dismayed when those frigates suffered damage and were destroyed.<ref name="Cargo of Doom" />

Federation vessels carried out the [[Blockade of Pantora/Legends|blockade of Pantora]] during the war. The incident was, on the surface, over outstanding payments [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]] owed the Federation. In truth, however, the blockade was designed to push the moon towards the CIS. With the reveal of [[Sib Canay/Legends|Sib Canay's]] Separatist loyalties, Senator [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] was forced to disavow the blockade, which was lifted.<ref name="Sphere" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Trade Federation Defense Fleet plays an important role in ''[[Rogue Planet]]'', where it is implied that it traditionally provided the military protection for Trade Federation cargo haulers. In ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'', however, no mention made of the separate defense fleet, and the LH-3210 freighters ''[[Revenue]]'' and [[Acquisitor (Lucrehulk-class battleship)|''Acquisitor'']] are depicted as armed, shielded, and protected by their own battle droids and starfighters in the period before the invasion of Naboo. It was the captain of one of these armed freighters, [[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]], who went on to command the invasion fleet at Naboo.
